EmailTemplate.subject: Exclusive Merch For Donors + FRIENDS!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for working hard to organize your upcoming blood drive. Your blood drive plays an important role during this time to ensure there are no delays in medical treatment for patients in need.
As we gather with loved ones to celebrate the season of giving, let's remember those who rely on the generosity of others.
When donors come to give blood Nov. 18-Dec. 8, 2024, they will receive two pairs of custom FRIENDS + Red Cross socks, ltd qty.^ Donors can keep a pair and gift a pair when they ask a friend to be there for patients, too, by scheduling a blood donation appointment!
As you continue the work to make your drive a success – remember to use these tips:
Share the attached email about these exciting incentives to recruit more blood donors! Fill your schedule. Use these tools to recruit blood donors and schedule them using the Blood Drive Management Portal. Encourage donors to schedule a donation for a friend. Each additional donor scheduled means more lives saved!
If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out – I’m always here to help!
All the best,
{Account Manager Name}
^Offer applicable to presenting donors only during the following dates: 11/18/2024-12/08/2024 and while supplies last. Offer subject to availability of donation opportunities in presenting donor’s area. No substitutions and not transferable by presenting donor.
